content: `URLDecoder.decode` implements application/x-www-form-urlencoded semantics, in which `+` is decoded to a space. In a URI *path* a `+` is a literal character, so any oss_key/filename containing `+` (or `%2B`) will be mis-resolved and the lookup/`UrlResource` will silently 404.
